properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Frontend base URL used for redirects and cross-origin requests.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed by CORS.

properties.name: app.token-encryptor-password
properties.description: Password used to encrypt stored tokens.

properties.name: app.token-encryptor-salt
properties.description: Salt used by the token encryptor.

properties.name: app.indexing.max-file-bytes
properties.description: Maximum file size in bytes accepted for indexing.

properties.name: app.indexing.chunk-size
properties.description: Number of tokens in each indexed chunk.

properties.name: app.indexing.chunk-overlap
properties.description: Number of overlapping tokens between indexed chunks.

properties.name: app.github.api-delay-ms
properties.description: Delay between GitHub API requests in milliseconds.
